expected: Whole flow played via captures with the focus on how this session's features interact (location card vs wake-up/descent, wake-up + subtitles + waypoints, scanner tags vs waypoint labels, clouds vs descent sky-follow, wildlife vs LOD/visibility, holo menus at 1280x720 @1.5 and reduced motion, power wave vs saved-game load, ascent -> ship arrival); highest-impact issues fixed with small presentation-only changes; checks green; perf within budget.
observed: About 75 captures (before, after, two verification rounds, a menu -> new campaign -> wake-up flow and a menu -> continue flow, one expedition -> ascent -> ship run). 11 issues fixed, 4 left open (see findings). check.sh (CHECK_FAST=1): compile 175 scripts 0 failed, loc_exit=0 tests_exit=0 (81 tests) smoke_exit=0 (58 checks) touch_exit=0 campaign_exit=0. Perf: 10 cases, 0 over budget (p95 8.9-10.8 ms, p50 8.0-8.5 ms). No SCRIPT ERROR in any capture log after the fixes.
fixture: fresh, power, none (menu with saves), orbit:viridia, approach:ferrum, expedition:viridia|pelagos|umbra|nivalis, grown:viridia|pelagos

findings.issue: The HUD (and its StoryPlayer) was hidden from the hatch opening (4.2 s, where intro_wakeup is triggered) to the end of the cinematic (9 s): the first line 'Cold. Then the sound of fans...' (5 s) ran out unseen.
findings.fix: ship_scene shows the story layer while ShipWakeup.is_open(); the cinematic's frost/black layer moved from canvas layer 30 to 15 (under the subtitles at 20).

findings.issue: ship_scene._process re-enabled the captain every frame (input_enabled false -> set_active(true)), so the invisible captain could walk and mouse-look turned the rig behind the cinematic.
findings.fix: ship_scene skips its activation logic while the wake-up runs; ShipWakeup freezes the camera rig (cursor stays captured) and hands over with captain.set_active(true).

findings.issue: expedition_complete (5 lines) is triggered by cmd_finish_expedition right before the ascent: the HUD was hidden during the climb and the surface scene's StoryPlayer was freed on the scene change, so the whole scene was lost (same for landing_commit before the colony).
findings.fix: StoryPlayer stores unfinished lines on _exit_tree (same GameState instance, < 15 s, not in test mode) and the next scene's player resumes them first; PlanetDescent keeps the GameHud's story layer visible over the descent/ascent.

findings.issue: [Enter] (skip_line) skipped the wake-up / descent and, in the same press, the subtitle line playing over it.
findings.fix: ShipWakeup and PlanetDescent consume skip_line in _unhandled_input (they still poll it to skip).

findings.issue: StoryPlayer and the voice player ran with PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS: lines advanced (and peeked out) behind the pause menu.
findings.fix: StoryPlayer and the VO player are pausable; the box hides while paused.

findings.issue: Scanner tags stacked on the waypoint layer's place name, the POI sign and the hazard sign of the same spot (same text twice, overlapping); hazards got '◆ ▲'; the relay beacon's glowing orb cut through the tag.
findings.fix: SurfaceScanner.tagged(node, seconds) -> WaypointLayer.hush() and the surface scene hides the POI/hazard Label3D meanwhile (objective keeps its diamond); no ◆ before ▲; tag render_priority 10.

findings.issue: The descent cloud deck (1.1-1.5 km) stayed at full presence below it: fogged into dark green blotches over the last few hundred metres (36 m: blotches over the whole sky) and vanished with a pop when the descent node was freed at touchdown.
findings.fix: presence *= smoothstep(650, 1000, alt); the world's PlanetSky cloud deck (which rides along overhead) is the sky below.

findings.issue: The stand-in globe (R 9 km) dips its horizon ~16 deg at 380 m; the band up to level showed the procedural sky's dark ground half as a murky stripe over the world.
findings.fix: While airborne the planet sky's ground colours blend to the horizon haze (in 0.03 steps, restored at touchdown).

findings.issue: fract(sin()) hash gave square blocks in the cryo-pod frost (first seconds of a new game) and inside the cloud puffs.
findings.fix: Sine-free hash in cryo_frost, cloud_puff, cloud_sky.

findings.issue: The CONTINUE caption over the save card washed out against the planet's bright limb (read as '...NTINUE').
findings.fix: Caption on a dark rounded pill with a thin amber edge.

findings.issue: 'Lambda capture at index 0 was freed' ~10 s into a new game (vapour timer lambda outlived the cinematic); 'Condition !is_inside_tree()' from SeaLeviathan._place on Pelagos colony build.
findings.fix: Vapour freed by its own tween; leviathan spray placed in local space.

findings.issue: --capture / --perf fixture campaigns autosave through real commands and overwrote the player's user://saves slots (the owner's autosave was replaced during this and earlier QA sessions).
findings.fix: SaveService uses user://saves_debug when DebugCapture/PerfProbe is requested.

findings.issue: --action=pause_load logs 'grab_focus: !is_inside_tree()' (open() defers focus to a main-menu entry that _load_menu frees in the same frame).
findings.reason: Only the debug capture calls open() and _load_menu() in one frame; players click Load later.

findings.issue: One of four scene_smoke runs logged dummy-renderer RID errors in TerrainBuilder.build (ArrayMesh.add_surface_from_arrays); 58/58 checks passed, not reproducible in the next run.
findings.reason: Engine dummy RID allocator flake in headless mode, code untouched.

findings.issue: With reduced motion ShipWakeup sets _t = 6.5 and _dur = 2.5, so it finishes on its first frame (no frost reveal at all).
findings.reason: Reads as a deliberate 'skip' for reduced motion; left for the owner to decide.

findings.issue: The approach flight's top-right status panel is still the plain pre-holo panel (D-059 did not cover it).
findings.reason: Visual consistency only; outside this round's interaction focus.

checked_without_findings: Location card vs wake-up: measured, the card is fully gone at t = 0.77 s of the cinematic, inside its 0-0.6 s black (first frame delta 0.14 s)
Power wave vs saved-game load: loading a powered save sets lights instantly ('init' path); the wave only follows the coupling
Wildlife vs descent/LOD: GroundWildlife hides with the site while in space and returns at the switch altitude; its processing stops while invisible
Holo menus (star map, orbit, embryo bank, workshop, settings, load, journal, colony overview, main menu settings) at 1280x720 @1.5 and with reduced motion: fit, no clipping
Wake-up -> waypoints: hidden during the cinematic, objective marker appears on hand-over
